subagent.title: Subagents
subagent.about: Helpers an agent hands work to, each with its own instructions and tools.
subagent.emptyDescription: Import the ones already in your agents' folders, or start a new one.

command.title: Commands
command.about: Slash commands: a saved prompt you run by typing /name.
command.emptyDescription: Import the ones already in your agents' folders, or start a new one.

rule.title: Rules
rule.about: Instructions an agent always follows, or follows for matching files. Most agents read rules only inside projects.
rule.emptyDescription: Import rules from a project or repository, or start a new one.

import.title: Import subagents, commands and rules
import.description: Each file is read into the library's format. Nothing is imported until you choose.
import.agentsHint: Files you or other tools put in your agents' own folders.
import.folderHint: A project or a checkout: agent folders like .claude/agents, and agents/, commands/, rules/ folders.
import.gitHint: A URL or owner/repo. It is downloaded to a temporary folder.
import.foundNone: No subagents, commands or rules there.

status.differs: The library has a different one

import.replace: Replace library items of the same name
import.skipped_one: {{count}} left out: the library has one of that name.
import.skipped_other: {{count}} left out: the library has ones of those names.

create.title: New {{kind}}
create.description: It starts from a template with the fields this kind uses.
create.name: Name
create.nameHint: Lowercase letters, digits, and single hyphens or underscores.
create.taken: There is already one with this name.
create.invalid: Use lowercase letters, digits, and single hyphens or underscores.

items.keptEdited_one: {{count}} file was changed in the agent's folder, so it was left there
items.keptEdited_other: {{count}} files were changed in agents' folders, so they were left there

detail.deleteDescription: It is taken out of the library and out of every agent folder it was deployed to. Files changed there are left alone.
detail.changedOnDisk: The file changed on disk since you opened it.
detail.missing: This item is no longer in the library.
detail.discardDescription: The edits you made are not saved and will be lost.

agents.globalHint: In each agent's own folder, for every project.
agents.projectsHint: In a linked project's folder for the agent. Most agents read rules only here.
agents.noProjects: Link a project on the Projects page to deploy into it.
agents.noProjectAgents: No agent reads this kind inside projects.
agents.replaceDescription: Loadout did not write this file. The old one is kept beside it as {{path}}.loadout-old, which no agent reads.

preview.title: What {{agent}} gets
preview.occupied: A file Loadout did not write is there now; deploying asks before replacing it.
preview.exact: Everything carries over as it is.

warnings.fields_dropped: Left out, as this agent has no such setting: {{fields}}.
warnings.tools_dropped: The tool list ({{tools}}) is left out: this agent names its tools differently, so it may use every tool.
warnings.tools_partly_mapped: These tools have no match in this agent and are left out: {{tools}}.
warnings.model_dropped: The model “{{model}}” is left out: this agent names models differently and uses its default.
warnings.positional_arguments: The text uses numbered arguments ($1, $ARGUMENTS[0]); check they mean the same in this agent.
warnings.several_patterns: Several file patterns ({{patterns}}); this agent may use only the first.
